_comment: Guided tour for the TTTR audifier. Steps point at real controls; the ones with an await wait until the user presses the control.

steps.title: What the audifier does
steps.text:
It turns a photon stream into sound and shows the same stream as a waterfall: macro-time (when) against micro-time or lifetime (how long after the pulse), each detector in its own colour. Louder means more photons.

Seven steps; you press the buttons, the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Load a stream
steps.text: Press Load TTTR and pick a photon file (or drop it on the window). A Becker & Hickl .spc needs its subtype chosen in the Detector setup window first (File Type).

steps.title: Detectors and colours
steps.text: Detector colours lists the detectors of the setup. Show includes one in the waterfall; double-click its colour to type another (#rrggbb).

steps.title: Channel notes
steps.text: Every routing channel plays its own chord. In Channel notes switch channels on and off, set pitch, gain and micro-time gate, and choose the chord of the selected row below the table.

steps.title: Compute the waterfall
steps.text: Choose micro-time or lifetime in Waterfall parameters, then press Update. The picture appears with its axes; wheel and drag zoom it.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: Play / Resume renders the selected channels and range with the Audio parameters; Pause, Stop and Revert control it, and a line follows the playback in the waterfall.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: Save WAV writes the same sound as a 16-bit mono WAV file. Press Help for the parameters.
